The correct way is to display the date using the browser culture. The dates you see are this way because the server is in Europe and it is using that server culture to format dates. It will eventually be modified to use your settings instead.

This culture also displays decimal and numbers differently too. 1.000,00 vs 1,000.00

Since this is a Swiss service (although hosted in germany) numbers should actually read 1'000.00

See: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Decimal_mark#Examples_of_use

I would propose following something like the ISO_8601 format to display dates.

It's less ambiguous than what is currently used.

E.g. I'm posting at date/time: 2015-02-18 03:48:11

If needed, the timezone can be included : 2015-02-18 03:48:11+00:00
